text:
Priya (platform): quick sync — we're building a unified token-cost / unit-econ dashboard for the Console. Need runtime + infra metric wiring: cost per 1k tokens, cache/batch savings breakdown, per-route/model/region dims. Who can own the metric defs?
Miguel (runtime): I can start. Runtime emits token counts and KV cache hits already but names are messy. Proposing stable metric names: token_count_total, token_count_input, token_count_output, cache_hit_tokens, batch_saved_tokens, gpu_seconds. Also will add model_variant tag and route_id tag.
Jules (data-eng): good. For ingestion we want a single telemetry topic: telemetry.token_usage.v1. Schema should be flat so downstream rollups are easy. Example event payload (proto-ish):
```
{
  "timestamp": 1650000000,
  "route_id": "chat-1",
  "model_variant": "gptx-16q",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "token_count_input": 42,
  "token_count_output": 318,
  "cache_hit_tokens": 120,
  "batch_saved_tokens": 80,
  "gpu_seconds": 0.023
}
```
Miguel (runtime): that looks fine. Two notes: 1) batch_saved_tokens should be computed at the worker level (we have the batching window). 2) cache_hit_tokens needs a definition: only include prefix hits where KV cache avoided recomputation, not partial prompts. I'll add those semantics to the metric doc.
Aisha (infra): on the infra side we map gpu_seconds -> $ via a price table keyed by instance_type + region + reserved/burst. We'll expose a price_lookup metric name: price_per_gpu_second (labels: instance_type, region, pricing_plan). Data-eng: join key will be region + instance_type. Also call out preemptible vs reserved pricing.
Sam (eng-platform): console/ dashboards need dimensions: route (api key + route_id), org_id, model_variant, region, timeframe. Also want derived metrics: cost_per_1k_tokens = (gpu_seconds * price_per_gpu_second) / (token_count_total/1000). And cache_savings_pct = cache_hit_tokens / token_count_total. Can we compute these in the metrics pipeline?
Jules (data-eng): yes, we can compute the rollups in materialized views. Plan: raw events -> kstreams -> daily/hourly rollups in clickhouse. We'll add pre-aggregates for per-route and per-org. Derived metrics as SQL views:
```sql
-- cost per 1k tokens (hourly)
SELECT hour, route_id, org_id, model_variant, region,
  SUM(gpu_seconds * price_per_gpu_second) / (SUM(token_count_total)/1000.0) as cost_per_1k_tokens
FROM telemetry_rollups_hourly
GROUP BY hour, route_id, org_id, model_variant, region;
```
Ben (product): we need this exposed in the Console with quick filters: time range, model, route, canary vs prod. For rollouts UX, important to show canary bucket cost delta and cache behavior (cache hit rate changes with rollout).
Priya (platform): +1 on canary visibility. Also quotas team needs per-org token burn signals for alerts. We should define an SLA flag on routes so dashboards can split prod vs non-prod.
Sam (eng-platform): I'll add route.slo=true/false tag and ensure quotas consumes the same telemetry topic for alerting. Also we should decide on roll-forward behavior: dashboards should support comparing two model_variant snapshots side-by-side.
Miguel (runtime): will emit model_snapshot_id label when a rollout happens. That gives direct compare ability. Also warning: early canary may have different batching patterns which will skew cost per 1k; we should surface sample sizes and median tokens per request.
Aisha (infra): timeline: price table export will be ready Tue EOD. We'll provide a batch CSV and API for historical joins.
Jules (data-eng): data ingestion proto + ClickHouse schema PR by Wed. Materialized views next week.
Priya (platform): deadline: want an initial Console tile and alert hooks by next Friday for exec review. Is that realistic?
Miguel (runtime): I can ship metric name changes + model_snapshot_id by Thu.
Sam (eng-platform): I'll prototype the tile using mock rollups by Thu night. If data-eng can't deliver full rollups, we can use hourly raw stream sampling as a fallback.
Ben (product): i'll prepare the UX copy and a help doc explaining "what counts as cache hit" and cost math.
Priya (platform): perfect. Ownership summary: runtime (Miguel) metrics + labels, infra (Aisha) price mapping, data-eng (Jules) ingestion + rollups, eng-platform (Sam) console wiring + SLO tag, product (Ben) UX/copy. I'll open a short RFC and link the telemetry schema.
metrics-bot: scheduled job telemetry.token_usage.etl started (job_id: etl-78321)
Miguel (runtime): small follow-up — we should include a `request_mode` label (sync/streaming/batch) because streaming calls have different token patterns. Adding that now.
Jules (data-eng): noted. Also adding a sampling flag for low-volume routes so aggregates don't get noisy.
Priya (platform): thanks everyone — I'll create the RFC and assign tasks. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Sam (eng-platform): tagging the dashboards epic so we don't lose this: #dash-416
Priya (platform): last ask — include a small example widget with before/after cache savings for a single route (7d compare). Helps PMs and SRE spot regressions.
Ben (product): love that.
